question: Does slow-link-gated path admission (experiments/v3_gated_pathspace, adopted under protocol v2 on C1) generalize to other GPU pools and to other cross-cluster bandwidths?
candidate: SlowLinkGatedScheduler, experiments/v3_gated_pathspace/scheduler.py unchanged (sha256 recorded per window); slow-link threshold 50 Mbps unchanged
control: frozen V3 M3 (GraphModeledQueueAwareDagScheduler with passive route recording) rerun in this environment on the same trace; released windows are not used because full-DAG V3 diverges across Python 3.10/3.13 on flat pools
layouts: frozen rcaps/v3_layouts/{C2,C3,multi}; no re-planning, so the test isolates the M3 admission rule

C2.network: flat 1000 Mbps; no slow link, admitted edges equal canonical edges

C3.network: flat 1000 Mbps; no slow link, admitted edges equal canonical edges

C1_multi_bw0.5.network: every link <= 50 Mbps (31 cross-cluster links incl. source/sink) x0.5

C1_multi_bw2.network: every link <= 50 Mbps x2 (still below the threshold, same 4 detours)

smoke: seed 100, 60 s, runner check only; not used for any decision

decision.relative_change: per seed (gated - v3) / v3, then averaged over the three seeds
decision.flat: P95 TPOT below frozen V3 on all three seeds, and mean relative throughput >= -0.5% (same as NI2 of experiments/v3_gated_pathspace/protocol.json)
decision.slow: mean relative P95 TPOT <= +2% and mean relative throughput >= -0.5% (same as NI1)
decision.per_condition: Each condition is judged and reported separately.
decision.generalizes_if: all four conditions pass; otherwise the claim is limited to the passing conditions and the failures are reported
decision.reported_not_decisive: P95 TTFT, completion fraction, end backlog, common-completed P95, decode batch statistics, paths used
decision.failures: A failed window is kept as .failure.json, counts as not passing for its condition, and is not rerun to fill the table.
decision.no_tuning: Scheduler, threshold, loads and margins are fixed before formal windows.
